# Souqivo

Canonical URL: https://souqivo.com/

Souqivo is a web-based client collaboration workspace for freelancers, agencies, and clients to manage project work from kickoff to approval.

Souqivo brings project management and Kanban tasks together with design reviews, client feedback and approvals, files and deliverables, project messaging, notifications, and invoices. It provides role-based access for freelancers/agencies and clients, including client access to projects they belong to.

Positioning: One workspace from kickoff to approval.

## Public information

- [Homepage and product overview](https://souqivo.com/)
- [Sitemap](https://souqivo.com/sitemap.xml)

Private workspace and project routes require authentication and are not public product-information pages.
